verification_scope_reason: Actual canonical CLI parses plugin --profile NAME recover DIRECTORY, restores a verified retained native snapshot without pnpm/network access, leaves the package disabled and removes the consumed recovery copy. Invalid arity refuses before fallback. A running canonical host blocks recovery and retains its only copy; retry after shutdown succeeds. A real backend-owned update scope with an injected failed restoration emits an actionable, correctly quoted command from a profile home containing spaces; the actual launcher executes that same argv after shutdown. Existing launcher-prefix/app-argument and shutdown consumers are included because help and command dispatch changed.
legal_adaptation: The native-only recovery command consumes the existing installed-file recovery provider. It does not execute the recovered package or reconstruct an original registry archive. The manager error gives the user a stop/recover action while the original browser code remains unchanged.
activation_boundary: Native recovery is actionable through the canonical CLI. Local/Git acquisition, default native manager bindings, update-disposal/mux/browser qualification and final C9 release gates remain pending.

cleanup.retained: Commands/XML only. All test recovery copies were consumed, then synthetic profiles and workspaces removed; shared Source/toolchains retained until C9.
